text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A-Ayaaa~!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
――Now then. I've handed back your test results, but...
It seems a few of you did downright catastrophically, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
It's a difficult unit, so test scores
tend to be lower than usual, but... even so!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Those who qualify will take a retest! If that fails, remedial classes!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Let's study hard...
so we don't have to cut into our training time!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... even if it's just this problem,
I should talk to Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, no no, Yukino!
I can't just rely on them for every little thing!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's rare to see you in a place like this, Yukino-chan.
Could you be in the middle of a "fashion lesson"?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Splendid, you're shining!
Even on days I can't teach you on the street,
you get outfit ideas from books...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh?
Those aren't fashion magazines, they're study books?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: F-Flight-san...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"And so, you see...
I gotta hold off on 'fashion' and study for now.
I don't wanna go makin' Trainer worry!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... I understand, and it has reaffirmed my belief.
Yukino-chan really is shining bright!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wha-whaaat!? I-It's shining...?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Her pure, innocent feelings for her Trainer,
and her admirable courage in trying to see it through alone...
It is truly wonderful!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So then, let's take a little break
from our "fashion lessons" and—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Instead... I will coordinate your study session!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah.
Come to think of it, Flight-san is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yukino Bijin seemed to be hiding something lately.
Walking down the hallway while worrying about how she was feeling..."

text_block_list.name: Morioka Dialect Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san... Just one last problem!
For this one... if we simplify the formula...
How's that look?

text_block_list.name: Polite Umamusume Instructor
text_block_list.text:
That's right♪
At this rate, you're sure to pass even with a few mistakes.
The subjects you struggle with offer the greatest room for growth.

text_block_list.name: Morioka Dialect Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Honi-honi... Thank you kindly, Flight-san!
As expected of someone so good at studying!

text_block_list.name: Morioka Dialect Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll definitely pass the retest!
After school, instead of remedial classes...
I wanna train with you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Polite Umamusume Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, I'm looking forward to it too.
To Yukino-chan's brand-new radiance!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, Yukino-chan's Trainer.
Should I call this a coincidence?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
This is the study room... or rather, a salon for maidens to converse.
Did you see or hear anything?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
The result of our coordination... will be revealed tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After school the next day. As I waited with a pounding
heart for Yukino Bijin, who had given an ambiguous answer
about whether she could train or not...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huff, puff... Am I a little late?
I'm terribly sorry.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still though, I'm just in the mood to run a whole bunch...
I'm in your hands today too, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Are you all done with your business?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~.
Seriously, it's all thanks to Flight-san... wait.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: "Wh-wh-what?! Ya knew about it?!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, how embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Regardless, since I passed, all's clear and bright!
Now then, let's get training!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I've had more'n enough of retakes—whoops!
It's nothin'!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'll do my best today too!
